strategyReview: The proven edges remain stationarity-style decays: weekend funding reversion is still the healthiest live family (69% win, +0.72 total PnL), monotonic arb is profitable, and the gated one-touch NO edge plus manual IV-touch rich NO continue to show contract-level edge. The failures are concentrated in unfiltered one-touch shadow selling, PM-proxy shorts, and momentum/confirmation longs that buy after the move is already obvious. Tonight's main lesson is that several struggling families are either testing the wrong instrument—contract edge vs spot move—or using absolute funding triggers that fire on ordinary noise.

failureClusters.evidence: The CBRS/AAPL/MU funding-reversion shadow families are 47%, 50%, and 29% wins. Their outcomes repeatedly show entries around already-neutral 5.5% readings or normal oscillations, not genuine extremes followed by reversion; e.g. CBRS -33.8%→9.0%→-6.2%→-33.6%.
failureClusters.recommendation: Replace raw absolute thresholds with regime-relative percentile/z-score conditions and require an upward turn in funding before entry. Kill any variant still using a single < -10 reading alone.

failureClusters.theme: One-touch contract edge mis-scored as spot directional call
failureClusters.evidence: H-534 gold underlying-cap edge has only 29% scorable wins plus 9 unscorable tests. The contract NO position gains small when premium decays, but the test predicted a >2% GOLD spot decline, which the edge never implied.
failureClusters.recommendation: Re-author these as contract premium fade theses, not spot-decline theses. Buy NO / sell YES and grade on contract P&L only.

failureClusters.evidence: The BTC listed-IV momentum family is at 21% win and cross-asset IV compression/HYPE confirmation is at 36%. Both buy when spot is already near the 7-day high with rising IV or HYPE strength, so they enter near exhaustion rather than before continuation.
failureClusters.recommendation: Stop creating continuation-long variants on rising IV near highs. Favor a fade or require a pullback confirmation before any long.

failureClusters.theme: Ungated one-touch NO shadow pool is negative
failureClusters.evidence: Overall ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO shadows show 47% win and -0.91 avg PnL, while the gated upside-only FIND-0020 subset is 101/164 wins and +0.84 avg PnL.
failureClusters.recommendation: Keep the broad signal disabled and concentrate only on gated above-strike variants with edge >= 3 points or matching the panel findings.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-534: replace the spot-decline prediction with a contract-premium fade. Enter GOLD above-strike one-touch NO through selling YES when cap edge is >=10 pts, near-dated, and tight-spread; exit as edge decays.
newHypotheses.prediction: Selling YES / buying NO on these GOLD above-strike one-touch contracts is profitable over 3 days as the touch premium decays.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-539: replace the absolute CBRS funding < -10 trigger with a relative 30-day funding extreme that is already turning up, avoiding stale or already-neutral 5.5% triggers.
newHypotheses.prediction: CBRS spot/perp rises >2% within 3 days after a relative funding low begins normalizing.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-537: use AAPL funding relative extreme plus an upward 24h turn instead of a raw sub -10 absolute level.
newHypotheses.prediction: AAPL spot/perp rises >2% within 3 days after extreme funding starts reversing.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-535: same relative-extreme and turning mechanism for MU funding, avoiding the stale 5.5% or only mildly negative readings.
newHypotheses.prediction: MU spot/perp rises >2% within 3 days after extreme funding starts reversing.

newHypotheses.description: Panel-derived NO edge, sharpest cut plus liquidity and tight-spread guard: sub-point sell-YES edge, mid-priced YES ask, near-dated, tight spread and liquid.
newHypotheses.prediction: Buying NO / selling YES on these mid-priced near-dated liquid tight-spread contracts is profitable over 7 days as YES premium decays.

newHypotheses.description: Panel-derived NO edge, above-strike variant: require touch_direction >=1, mid-priced YES ask, near-dated and tight spread.
newHypotheses.prediction: Buying NO / selling YES on above-strike contracts satisfying these conditions is profitable over 7 days as YES premium decays.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The variant won only on contract marks such as NO 0.935→0.945, but the spot-decline prediction missed the actual mechanism. Nine tests were unscorable because the setup captures overpriced touch premium, not spot direction.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large gold underlying-cap edge on upside one-touch NO contracts predicts a >2% GOLD spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Single CBRS funding < -10 produced only 47% wins and non-normalizing oscillations. Triggers fired on already-neutral or only mildly negative funding and often failed to signal a 2-day reversion.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single CBRS funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes within 2 days and forces a >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: AAPL < -10 behaved similarly: many triggers occurred around 5.5% or neutral rates, and wins were mostly small normalization events rather than >2% spot moves.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: AAPL funding below -10% on any day reliably normalizes and yields a >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: MU was the worst of the three funding families at 29% win. Many outcomes were stale 5.5%→5.5% readings, and a single negative funding print did not isolate an extreme stress/reversion setup.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single MU funding reading below -10% reliably predicts normalization and a >2% MU spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The HYPE confirmation variant underperformed with losses when BTC was already near highs. HYPE acted as a lagging echo of the same risk-on move rather than an independent predictor.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE risk-on participation independently confirms durable BTC upside rather than late-stage FOMO/overextension.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Long call underperformed at 21% family win. Tests show entry after spot is already above the short-term SMA near the 7d high and IV has risen, which is often the exhaustion zone. The test record also contains directionally opposite short losses during the Aug 18 BTC rally, adding noise.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: BTC spot momentum confirmed by rising listed option IV reliably leads to further >2% spot gains within 3-7 days.

journalEntry: Tonight's main finding is that the one-touch NO edge must be expressed as a contract premium fade, not a spot-directional bet. Several 'struggling' families are really cases where the test instrument and thesis instrument disagree. For the funding families, absolute < -10 thresholds are not an edge; regime-relative extremes with a turn are the better mechanism. No risk parameters were changed because live signal-level evidence does not currently justify a stop/target adjustment beyond the existing asset disables.
